blocks.text: WSJ：Anthropic 预计其 IPO 定价将高于每股 70 至 78 美元的区间，可能超过每股 80 美元，其顾问已讨论过 1.5 万亿或 1.6 万亿美元的估值，高于约 1.33 万亿美元。

inlines.text: WSJ：Anthropic 预计其 IPO 定价将高于每股 70 至 78 美元的区间，可能超过每股 80 美元，其顾问已讨论过 1.5 万亿或 1.6 万亿美元的估值，高于约 1.33 万亿美元。

blocks.text: 按申报区间计算，此次 IPO 总额约为 610 亿美元，同时还有一项 260 亿美元的私募配售，其中 Google 和 Nvidia 各以 IPO 价格购买约 100 亿美元。

blocks.text: WSJ: Anthropic expects to price its IPO above its $70 to $78 range, possibly beyond $80 a share, and its advisers have discussed a $1.5T or $1.6T valuation, up from about $1.33T.

blocks.text: At the filed range, the IPO totals about $61B, alongside a $26B private placement in which Google and Nvidia each buy about $10B at the IPO price.
